summary: Feed s141_double is degraded: 100% of traffic is untagged (required VLANs 10, 20 missing) and 1ms bursts peak at 21.64 Gbps, 216% of the 10 Gbps APM port capacity.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or filtering VLANs 10 and 20 upstream; 100% of sampled packets arrived untagged so required VLANs are invisible to the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM cannot segment, filter or correlate by VLAN 10/20, losing application context and potentially missing or misattributing transactions that rely on VLAN identification.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the packet broker to restore APM visibility and filtering by required segments.

findings.root_cause: Aggregated microbursts peak at 21.64 Gbps in a 1ms interval, exceeding the single 10 Gbps APM port by 216% (2 overloaded intervals) with no load balancing or shaping in front of the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM ingress will drop packets during bursts, causing incomplete flows, inaccurate latency/error metrics and missed application performance detections.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute bursts across multiple 10 Gbps tool ports (or add buffering/shaping) to keep peak below per-port capacity and prevent drops while preserving both directions for APM.
